title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Eye Infection
intro: Herbal creams for eye infection are topical treatments made from natural herbs, plants, and botanicals that help soothe and heal irritated or infected eyes. These creams offer several benefits, including reducing inflammation, fighting off bacterial and fungal infections, and promoting overall eye health. Examples of herbal creams used to treat eye infections include those made from aloe vera, which has anti-inflammatory properties; chamomile, which calms and soothes the eyes; tea tree oil, which has antimicrobial properties; calendula, which has antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties; and echinacea, which boosts the immune system and fights off infections. Additionally, herbal creams made from ingredients like licorice root, goldenseal, and ginkgo biloba are also effective in treating eye infections due to their antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis creams have been widely used to treat eye infections, such as conjunctivitis, due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents, including triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and carotenoids, in Calendula officinalis creams help to soothe and calm the affected area, reducing redness and swelling. These creams work by inhibiting the growth of pathogens and promoting the healing of the cornea, thereby alleviating symptoms associated with eye infections. The benefits of using Calendula officinalis creams to treat eye infections include reduced risk of complications, faster recovery, and minimal side effects, making it a popular natural remedy for this condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study published in "Journal of ethnopharmacology", Calendula officinalis creams have been found to be effective for ophthalmological problems, specifically eye infection, based on ethnobotanical and ethnopharmacological studies.

preparations.preparation_desc: Symphytum officinale creams, also known as comfrey creams, have been traditionally used to treat eye infections such as conjunctivitis due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents, including allantoin, rosmarinic acid, and triterpenoid saponins, help to reduce inflammation and combat bacterial and viral infections in the eyes. These creams work by soothing the affected area, reducing redness and swelling, and promoting the healing of the eye tissue, thus helping to alleviate symptoms and promote recovery. The benefits of using Symphytum officinale creams to treat eye infections include their natural and non-invasive approach, minimal side effects, and ability to promote long-term eye health.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "BMC veterinary research", Hypericum perforatum creams for eye infection may have antibacterial and antifungal effects, including against antibiotic-resistant bacteria, potentially making them an interesting option for the treatment of eye infections in dogs.
